name: PHP
description: PHP powers over 75% of all websites, including WordPress, Laravel applications, and massive platforms like Facebook. It is the most accessible backend language with an unmatched ecosystem. These are the definitive free resources — vetted, current, and complete.

items.title: PHP: The Right Way
items.description: The de facto standard reference for modern PHP best practices, coding standards, and ecosystem recommendations.

items.title: PHP Manual
items.description: The complete PHP language reference and tutorial. The definitive source of truth for syntax, functions, and features.

items.title: PHP.net Documentation
items.description: The official PHP documentation with language reference, function listing, and getting-started guides.

items.title: PHP The Right Way Reference
items.description: A community-driven reference covering modern PHP patterns, dependency management, testing, and security.

items.title: Laravel Documentation
items.description: The comprehensive documentation for the Laravel framework — the most popular PHP web framework.

items.title: freeCodeCamp — PHP Course
items.description: Free PHP tutorials and courses covering everything from basic syntax to building full web applications.

items.title: Laracasts — PHP Free Lessons
items.description: High-quality screencasts for PHP and Laravel development. Hundreds of free lessons available for beginners.

items.title: PHP Programming Language Full Course (freeCodeCamp)
items.description: A multi-hour comprehensive video course covering PHP from fundamentals to database-driven web applications.

items.title: Laravel Tutorial for Beginners (freeCodeCamp)
items.description: A full Laravel framework course covering MVC architecture, Eloquent ORM, blade templating, and deployment.

items.title: Exercism — PHP Track
items.description: 100+ free coding exercises with automated analysis and optional human mentoring for personalized feedback.

items.title: Codewars — PHP Kata
items.description: Solve community-created challenges in PHP across hundreds of difficulty levels and topics.

items.title: HackerRank — PHP Domain
items.description: Practice PHP-specific challenges covering basic syntax, functions, arrays, and advanced features.

items.title: PHP Cheatsheet (devhints)
items.description: A concise one-page reference covering PHP syntax, arrays, functions, classes, and PDO database access.

items.title: PHP Type Comparison Table
items.description: Essential reference for understanding PHP type juggling, comparison behavior, and strict typing.

items.title: PHP Weekly
items.description: A free weekly newsletter covering PHP articles, frameworks, tools, and community news.

items.title: PHP.net Announcements
items.description: Official PHP.net release announcements, security advisories, and version update information.

items.title: Reddit r/php
items.description: The main community for PHP discussions, news, and project showcases.

items.title: PHP Discord
items.description: Active real-time chat community for PHP developers with channels for help, code review, and job discussions.

items.title: Stack Overflow — PHP Tag
items.description: The definitive Q&A forum for PHP troubleshooting, best practices, and debugging help.

lessons.title: Fundamentals of PHP
lessons.description: Core concepts, syntax, and first steps with PHP
